rules.statement: In a defamation suit where the plaintiff seeks an interim injunction, they must establish that the matter complained of is defamatory and that no defense such as truth or public benefit can be set up.
rules.supporting_quote: "In a defamation suit the plaintiff must in addition establish (i) That the matter complained of is defamatory, (ii) No defence such as truth or public benefit can be set up"

meta.parties: Felix Dias Bandaranayake v. The State Film Corporation and Another
